fact: The Unlocking Data Initiative policy brief says cohort tracking within the EMIS generates longitudinal learner-level data through Learner Identification Numbers assigned to pupils on entry to school, though the data has rarely been analysed since 2012.
Malawi's Ministry of Education says it is moving from fragmented reporting towards a more connected EMIS and has developed a five-pillar EMIS governance framework including a national data warehouse.
The education ministry's Malawi Education Statistics Report 2023/24, an EMIS product of the 2023/24 Annual School Census, counts 5,420,159 primary pupils and 538,800 secondary students.
